content.short: Router Protocol provides an extensive multi-directional bridge for contract-level data flow across different L1s and L2s.
content.description: Router Protocol acts as a cross-chain interoperability layer, connecting diverse blockchains to enable asset transfers and cross-chain smart contract interactions across networks. Its infrastructure runs on nine EVM-compatible chains: Ethereum, BSC, Fantom, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Aurora, and Kava. The suite includes Voyager, a flagship DApp that enables swaps from any asset to any asset, and CrossTalk, a communication layer for cross-chain smart contracts that enables use cases such as lending and staking. More information is available in the project documentation.
